purpose: Generated illustrative beauty reference imagery for Ellen Studio catalogue; not real client work
inspection: Every generated image visually inspected from full returned image

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: standalone beauty catalogue reference photograph for a refined studio website. This is illustrative generated imagery, not documentation of real client work.
Style/medium: highly realistic professional beauty photography, honest skin pores, fine hairs and natural skin texture; restrained elegant studio feel.
Lighting/mood: soft diffused natural window light, gentle shadows, neutral exposure.
Color palette: ivory, powder rose and deep brown.
Constraints: no text, no logo, no watermark, no tools, no jewellery, no collage, no before-and-after layout.
Composition/framing: vertical portrait photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio. Close crop of ONE anatomically correct adult hand with five fingers in a relaxed natural pose, all five fingernails clearly readable and in focus against a tasteful matte ivory background. Warm medium-light skin.
Nails: real NATURAL SHORT fingernails, short squoval shape, edge just at fingertip, slim natural profile. Extremely simple manicure appropriate for easy everyday nail art.
Avoid: long nails, extensions, thick gel, sculpted apex, coffin or almond shape, gems, beads, 3D decoration, elaborate artwork, extra fingers, duplicate fingers, a second hand.
Primary request: sheer nude base on every nail with a very fine pastel pink French tip. Simple identical shallow smile lines on all five nails. Keep each pink tip narrow, delicate, even and clearly visible. No other nail art.
assets.qa: One anatomically plausible five-finger adult hand. Short natural-looking squoval nails and thin pastel pink tips are clearly visible, with even smile lines. Skin texture and ivory background are realistic. Thumb is viewed more obliquely than other nails.
